name: LocalColabFold
summary: Local protein and complex structure prediction using the ColabFold workflow.

steps: Use the LocalColabFold maintainer instructions for the current platform; Windows users first need WSL2.
Review the selected installer and its dependencies before running it. Check GPU drivers, expected model-weight downloads, disk space, and the user's chosen isolated location.
Ask whether sequence/MSA work may use an external server. For fully local processing, follow the documented local database and colabfold_search route instead.
install.verify_note: Run colabfold_batch --help in the installed environment before any prediction; test inference and MSA routing separately with user-approved inputs.

notes: Local inference does not by itself guarantee local-only MSA processing. The official local database option adds substantial downloads and setup.
